topic: Hammer and feather drop on the Moon
hook: Your hammer and feather would hit the Moon together.
title: Hammer and Feather Fell Together on the Moon
description:
In 1971, Apollo 15 astronaut David Scott dropped a hammer and a feather at the same time on camera. They landed together because the Moon has almost no air to slow the feather. Series: Things That Sound Fake.

#Shorts #Space #Apollo15
comment_prompt: Hammer or feather, which would you bet on? Hammer or feather

scenes.narration: Your hammer and feather would hit the Moon together.
scenes.headline: HAMMER VS FEATHER

scenes.narration: Apollo 15 astronaut David Scott actually did it.
scenes.headline: DAVID SCOTT

scenes.narration: They landed at the exact same moment.
scenes.headline: SAME MOMENT

scenes.narration: On Earth, air slows the feather down.
scenes.headline: AIR SLOWS IT

scenes.narration: The Moon has almost no air at all.
scenes.headline: ALMOST NO AIR

scenes.narration: So gravity pulls everything down equally fast.
scenes.headline: EQUAL FALL

scenes.narration: It was 1971, and the camera caught it.
scenes.headline: CAUGHT ON CAMERA

scenes.narration: Your hammer and feather fall together up there.
